notes: Introduced the Wavely MPC Sampler & Pad Slicer Studio with live pad performance recording, real-time PCM audio capture, instant WAV/MP3 export, direct DAW drag-and-drop, 1-click individual chop folder export, and standard Type 0 SMF MIDI clip (.mid) generation; Added the Procedural Random Chop Sequencer with an interactive 16-step visual rack, style presets (Bounce, Breakbeat, Glitch, Trap), custom interactive BPM tempo controls with instant real-time reactivity, and flexible step speed grid rates (1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16); Overhauled the Wavely Demo Analyser to automatically synchronize with active playing pack demos, added 1-click 'Open in Analyser' buttons to PlayerBar and pack cards, implemented real acoustic waveform feature extraction, BPM tempo matching, full drum loop/break prioritization, and strict pack-only candidate scoping; Integrated local GPU-accelerated Demucs AI Stem Separation with a 4-stem studio mixer (Drums, Bass, Vocals, Other) featuring solo/mute controls, volume faders, and individual DAW drag handles; Added a custom in-app update celebration popup with multi-colored 60 FPS canvas confetti particle physics, live download progress bar, and silent IPC updater; Overhauled the bottom PlayerBar with a responsive CSS Grid layout to eliminate UI overlapping across all screen widths; Fixed audio playback freezes with a high-performance in-memory XOR descrambler and added automatic pack preview demo audio downloads; Updated the application, updater, licensing client, sidebar, release manifest, and build metadata consistently to version 1.0.7.
